ddl.name: broken_rounds
ddl.definition:
SELECT b.run_id, b.target_id, t.width, b.round, b.broken_by, b.broken,
  EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM design_rounds x WHERE x.run_id = b.run_id AND x.target_id = b.target_id AND x.round > b.round
    AND x.broken IS NULL) AS fixed_after
FROM design_rounds b
JOIN design_targets t ON t.run_id = b.run_id AND t.target_id = b.target_id
WHERE b.broken IS NOT NULL

ddl.name: fom_nodes
ddl.definition:
SELECT f.seq, f.target_id, f.run_id, f.id, f.node, f.name, f.instance, f.source, f.site, f.confidence,
  f.margin, f.round, f.voted_round, f.revoted_round, f.reason, f.at, n.type, n.within, n.depth, n.x, n.y, n.w, n.h,
  n.fill_kind, n.fill, n.fill_opacity, n.stroke, n.stroke_weight, n.radius, n.font_family, n.font_weight, n.font_size,
  n.line_height, n.text_align, n.text, n.opacity, n.image, n.asset, n.token_fill, n.token_stroke, n.token_radius,
  n.token_font, n.token_gap, n.token_padding
FROM design_fom f
LEFT JOIN design_nodes n ON n.run_id = f.run_id AND n.target_id = f.target_id AND n.node = f.node

ddl.name: hint_vs_drawn
ddl.definition:
WITH got AS (
  SELECT c.run_id, json_extract(c.reply, '$.target') AS target_id, n.value AS node
  FROM design_tool_calls c, json_each(c.reply, '$.nodes') n
  WHERE c.tool = 'design_get' AND c.reply IS NOT NULL
  UNION ALL
  SELECT c.run_id, json_extract(v.value, '$.target'), n.value
  FROM design_tool_calls c, json_each(c.reply, '$.variants') v, json_each(v.value, '$.nodes') n
  WHERE c.tool = 'design_get' AND c.reply IS NOT NULL
), hints AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT run_id, target_id, json_extract(node, '$.id') AS node,
    json_extract(node, '$.hint.component') AS hint, json_extract(node, '$.hint.specifier') AS hint_specifier
  FROM got WHERE json_extract(node, '$.hint') IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT h.run_id, h.target_id, r.round, h.node, h.hint, h.hint_specifier,
  group_concat(DISTINCT nc.component) AS drawn,
  coalesce(max(nc.component = h.hint AND nc.specifier = h.hint_specifier), 0) AS same
FROM hints h
LEFT JOIN design_rounds r ON r.run_id = h.run_id AND r.target_id = h.target_id
LEFT JOIN design_node_components nc ON nc.run_id = h.run_id AND nc.target_id = h.target_id
  AND nc.round = r.round AND nc.node = h.node
GROUP BY h.run_id, h.target_id, r.round, h.node, h.hint, h.hint_specifier

ddl.name: judged
ddl.definition:
SELECT s.run_id, r.wave, r.lane, s.arm, s.model, s.harness, s.agent_id, s.status, s.cost, s.usage, s.error,
  s.error_code, s.duration_ms, s.target_id, s.width, s.verdict, s.rows, s.pixels, j.score, j.reason
FROM run_summary s
JOIN design_runs r ON r.run_id = s.run_id
LEFT JOIN design_judgements j ON j.run_id = s.run_id AND j.target_id = s.target_id AND j.width = s.width
WHERE s.round IS NOT NULL

ddl.name: kit_per_round
ddl.definition:
SELECT run_id, target_id, round, component_id, component, specifier, count(DISTINCT node) AS nodes
FROM design_node_components GROUP BY run_id, target_id, round, component_id, component, specifier

ddl.name: lost_components
ddl.definition:
SELECT run_id, target_id, round, node, component, specifier
FROM design_rows WHERE magnitude = 'component'

ddl.name: lowest_rendered
ddl.definition:
WITH ranked AS (
  SELECT run_id, target_id, round, rendered, nodes,
    row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY run_id, target_id ORDER BY rendered, round) AS low,
    row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY run_id, target_id ORDER BY round DESC) AS late
  FROM design_rounds WHERE nodes > 0
)
SELECT l.run_id, l.target_id, t.width, l.rendered AS lowest, l.nodes, l.round, z.rendered AS last_rendered
FROM ranked l
JOIN ranked z ON z.run_id = l.run_id AND z.target_id = l.target_id AND z.late = 1
JOIN design_targets t ON t.run_id = l.run_id AND t.target_id = l.target_id
WHERE l.low = 1

ddl.name: mispairs
ddl.definition:
WITH ranked AS (
  SELECT run_id, target_id, round, node, path, total, won,
    row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY run_id, target_id, round, node ORDER BY total DESC) AS place
  FROM design_votes
), winners AS (
  SELECT w.run_id, w.target_id, w.round, w.node, w.path, f.total - coalesce(s.total, 0) AS margin
  FROM ranked w
  JOIN ranked f ON f.run_id = w.run_id AND f.target_id = w.target_id AND f.round = w.round
    AND f.node = w.node AND f.place = 1
  LEFT JOIN ranked s ON s.run_id = w.run_id AND s.target_id = w.target_id AND s.round = w.round
    AND s.node = w.node AND s.place = 2
  WHERE w.won = 1
), paths AS (
  SELECT run_id, target_id, node, round, path, margin,
    lag(path) OVER (PARTITION BY run_id, target_id, node ORDER BY round) AS before,
    first_value(round) OVER (PARTITION BY run_id, target_id, node ORDER BY round) AS first_round,
    first_value(path) OVER (PARTITION BY run_id, target_id, node ORDER BY round) AS first_path
  FROM winners
)
SELECT run_id, target_id, node, first_round, first_path, round, before, path, margin
FROM paths WHERE before IS NOT NULL AND before <> path AND margin < 0.08

ddl.name: page_height_rows
ddl.definition:
SELECT r.run_id, r.target_id, t.width, r.round, r.text, last.round AS last_round,
  (SELECT max(p.round) FROM design_rows p WHERE p.run_id = r.run_id AND p.target_id = r.target_id AND p.kind = 'page')
    < last.round AS fixed
FROM design_rows r
JOIN design_targets t ON t.run_id = r.run_id AND t.target_id = r.target_id
JOIN (SELECT run_id, target_id, max(round) AS round FROM design_rounds GROUP BY run_id, target_id) last
  ON last.run_id = r.run_id AND last.target_id = r.target_id
WHERE r.kind = 'page'

ddl.name: round_rows
ddl.definition:
SELECT run_id, target_id, round, kind, magnitude, count(*) AS count
FROM design_rows GROUP BY run_id, target_id, round, kind, magnitude

ddl.name: run_summary
ddl.definition:
SELECT r.run_id, r.wave, r.lane, r.model, r.harness, r.agent_id, r.arm, r.status, r.ended, r.cost, r.usage, r.error, r.error_code,
  (r.ended - r.started) / 60000.0 AS minutes, r.ended - r.started AS duration_ms, r.verdict AS run_verdict,
  t.target_id, t.width, last.round, last.verdict, last.rows_count AS rows, last.much, last.noticeably, last.slightly,
  last.reflow, last.paint, last.pixel_share AS pixels,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM design_tool_calls c
    WHERE c.run_id = r.run_id AND c.tool = 'design_check' AND (r.ended IS NULL OR c.at <= r.ended)) AS checks
FROM design_runs r
LEFT JOIN design_targets t ON t.run_id = r.run_id
LEFT JOIN design_rounds last ON last.run_id = t.run_id AND last.target_id = t.target_id
  AND last.round = (SELECT max(x.round) FROM design_rounds x WHERE x.run_id = t.run_id AND x.target_id = t.target_id
    AND (r.ended IS NULL OR x.at <= r.ended))

ddl.name: wave_summary
ddl.definition:
WITH base AS (
  SELECT r.wave, s.arm, s.width, s.run_id, s.run_verdict, s.rows, s.pixels, s.cost, l.lowest
  FROM run_summary s
  JOIN design_runs r ON r.run_id = s.run_id
  LEFT JOIN lowest_rendered l ON l.run_id = s.run_id AND l.target_id = s.target_id
  WHERE s.round IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT g.wave, g.arm, g.width, count(DISTINCT g.run_id) AS runs,
  count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN g.run_verdict = 'done' THEN g.run_id END) AS done,
  (SELECT avg(v) FROM (SELECT x."rows" AS v, row_number() OVER (ORDER BY x."rows") AS i, count(*) OVER () AS n
  FROM base x WHERE x.wave IS g.wave AND x.arm IS g.arm AND x.width = g.width AND x."rows" IS NOT NULL) WHERE i IN ((n + 1) / 2, (n + 2) / 2)) AS median_rows, (SELECT avg(v) FROM (SELECT x."pixels" AS v, row_number() OVER (ORDER BY x."pixels") AS i, count(*) OVER () AS n
  FROM base x WHERE x.wave IS g.wave AND x.arm IS g.arm AND x.width = g.width AND x."pixels" IS NOT NULL) WHERE i IN ((n + 1) / 2, (n + 2) / 2)) AS median_pixels, (SELECT avg(v) FROM (SELECT x."cost" AS v, row_number() OVER (ORDER BY x."cost") AS i, count(*) OVER () AS n
  FROM base x WHERE x.wave IS g.wave AND x.arm IS g.arm AND x.width = g.width AND x."cost" IS NOT NULL) WHERE i IN ((n + 1) / 2, (n + 2) / 2)) AS median_cost,
  (SELECT avg(v) FROM (SELECT x."lowest" AS v, row_number() OVER (ORDER BY x."lowest") AS i, count(*) OVER () AS n
  FROM base x WHERE x.wave IS g.wave AND x.arm IS g.arm AND x.width = g.width AND x."lowest" IS NOT NULL) WHERE i IN ((n + 1) / 2, (n + 2) / 2)) AS median_lowest_rendered
FROM base g GROUP BY g.wave, g.arm, g.width
